                             Trouble with broken bubbles, pinholes/pitting, not smoothing out.

                                                                                                                                 Peter Liekkio
                                                                                                        3 years ago

                                                                                                                    In the first photo with the bowls is that +2% cu carb to the
                                                                                        base (6%total)? I'm assuming that since the 2% On little
                                                                                                             loafers clay is so much lighter in color (not familar with that
                                                                                                          clay so not sure how much that effects color). Really liking all
                                                                                                  the colors and will be doing some testing myself. Thanks for
                                                                                                         posting.



                                                                                                                                           Austin Geithner
                                                                                                              3 years ago

                                                                                                          Peter Liekkio it’s 2% total in the base recipe. That
                                                                                              example was fire on standard 182 to cone 6 electric.

I’ve only tried it on light bodied stoneware and
       porcelain. Not sure how it would look on a darker clay
     body either.


         It’s an interesting glaze by itself when layered with
      other glazes. Adding different colorants definitely
     makes for some interesting effects.


           I should mention that my examples were a bit odd.
     They were rather stable and did not run. In most cases,
       this glaze tends to run a lot, so definitely test it out.
